ANG-NS-001.name: Stop-Scroll Identification
ANG-NS-001.customer: Breastfeeding or formula-feeding mother, 0-12 weeks postpartum, doing 100% of night care while her partner sleeps through or is minimally involved
ANG-NS-001.emotion: She is not just tired — she keeps score alone. Every uninterrupted hour he gets feels like proof her exhaustion is invisible, and naming it makes her the difficult one. Rage at his calm breathing while she feeds, grief for the relationship, and fear that this is now permanent.

ANG-NS-004.name: Story Sequence
ANG-NS-004.customer: Breastfeeding or formula-feeding mother, 0-12 weeks postpartum, doing 100% of night care with no partner in the home at all
ANG-NS-004.emotion: She is not just tired — she keeps score alone. Nobody helps you; you are all by yourself. Every uninterrupted hour someone else gets feels like proof her exhaustion is invisible.

FAM-NS-001.name: Mental load of night coordination is the real problem, not night waking itself

FAM-NS-002.name: The resentment spiral: you manage everything, they 'don't get it', you lose yourself — this is the problem to solve before it solves you

FAM-NS-003.name: The 'minimal effort partner' myth: working tomorrow ≠ can't help tonight — 3 hours of broken sleep isn't rest, it's survival

FAM-NS-004.name: The single parent: no partner to argue with, just exhaustion. The system still works — it builds recovery windows you design for yourself

FAM-NS-005.name: The breastfeeding trap: 'I can't help because the baby won't take a bottle' — but night shifts aren't just feeds. The roster covers the rest.

VG-NS-STOP-001.label: Tired new parent caught mid-scroll at 2am, phone screen reflecting on face
VG-NS-STOP-001.scene: Tired new parent caught mid-scroll at 2am, phone screen reflecting on face
VG-NS-STOP-001.mood: Exhaustion mixed with quiet frustration. Not crying, not smiling — just tired and scrolling.
VG-NS-STOP-001.lighting: Phone screen as key practical light on face. Warm bedside lamp or nightlight as fill. Deep shadows elsewhere. Night scene.

VG-NS-PROB-001.label: Tired parent at kitchen table, head in one hand, looking at phone with a text message visible
VG-NS-PROB-001.scene: Tired parent at kitchen table, head in one hand, looking at phone with a text message visible
VG-NS-PROB-001.mood: Resentment building under exhaustion. Not explosive — slow burn. The face of someone who has asked and stopped asking.
VG-NS-PROB-001.lighting: Flat overhead kitchen light. No warmth. Functional, not atmospheric.
